authority: Current conversation: build and try a learned Balatro agent today; explicitly use RTX 5090 GPU training, model as large as useful; research modern efficiency and game learning. Supersedes historical no-neural/GPU clause only for this isolated prototype. No historical allowance reused.
hypothesis: A public-information, candidate-conditioned GPU policy can learn useful action selection in a fast isolated simulator. First measure interface correctness, learning signal and throughput; no claim of retail qualification or better win rate.
profile: isolated simulator default catalog, not player profile

design.partition: disjoint namespace-hashed seed families; final evaluation after model choice; no seed selection for favorable outcomes
design.win_definition: Simulator final Ante8 boss clear and won latch before endless mode; separately retain threshold and phase evidence
design.censoring: Unsupported/errors/limits retained separately. No fabricated terminal labels. Final records not recycled into training in this experiment.
metrics: win fraction only with population and censoring reported
design.selection: Development results may guide later registered jobs; final evaluation is descriptive pilot evidence, not proof of competence.

P01.purpose: Device, memory, BF16 versus FP32 finite numerical check; no games

T02.purpose: Measured successor pilot, selected using development evidence

T03.purpose: One bounded repair or continuation pilot if useful

one_use: Exclusive job directory consumes each lease including setup error/timeout. Jobs cannot be rerun or replaced by new directory. Closing closes all unused jobs. Each job freezes implementation, simulator, arguments, profile and Python runtime before execution. No CPU training, installations, promotions or automatic continuation.
